title: Extreme Jungle – Special Wildlife & Big Cat Expedition – 15 Days
overview: Our most demanding and rewarding safari expedition, entirely dedicated to passionate wildlife photographers, naturalists, and big cat trackers. 15 intensive days exploring Chitwan, Bardia, and the remote grasslands of Suklaphanta targeting Bengal tigers, leopards, one-horned rhinos, and rare marsh deer.
highlights: Maximum field hours: dawn-to-dusk tracking with elite native wildlife spotters
Exploration of 3 premier wildlife sanctuaries: Chitwan, Bardia, and Suklaphanta
Strategic river hides, watchtowers (machans), and riverside waiting posts
Unrivaled photographic opportunities under optimal natural lighting

days.title: Day 1 – Arrival in Kathmandu
days.desc: Welcome at Tribhuvan International Airport by our local team. Private transfer to your hotel in Kathmandu. Rest after your flight, explore Thamel's vibrant streets, and attend the evening expedition briefing with Robin and our team.

days.title: Day 2 – Cultural Day in Kathmandu Valley
days.desc: Discover the sacred spiritual heritage of Kathmandu: Swayambhunath stupa, Patan Durbar Square, and Pashupatinath. Equipment check and final preparations for the safari.

days.title: Day 3 – Drive to Chitwan National Park
days.desc: Scenic 5-hour drive descending through the Trishuli river valley into Chitwan. Check-in at the eco-lodge, late afternoon nature walk along the Rapti River, and early dinner.

days.title: Day 4 – Full-Day 4x4 Safari in Chitwan
days.desc: Spend the entire day inside Chitwan National Park tracking Greater One-Horned Rhinos, sloth bears, and Asian leopards. Picnic lunch inside the park.

days.title: Day 5 – Drive to Lumbini & Spiritual Pause
days.desc: Drive west across the Terai plains to Lumbini (4 hours). Visit the sacred birthplace of Lord Buddha, peaceful monasteries, and prepare for the long drive into Western Nepal.

days.title: Day 6 – Journey to Bardia National Park
days.desc: Scenic 6 to 7-hour road journey through rural Terai farmland and sal forests to Bardia National Park. Settle into our authentic jungle lodge. Evening briefing with Pawan.

days.title: Day 7 – First Full-Day Walking Safari in Bardia
days.desc: Enter the jungle on foot at sunrise with two certified Tharu master trackers. Walk along tiger corridors, riverbanks, and elephant grass clearings. High-adrenaline tracking on foot.

days.title: Day 8 – Second Full-Day Walking Safari in Core Tiger Zones
days.desc: A second full day dedicated to tracking big cats on foot. Strategic waits at prime waterholes and riverbanks. Picnic lunch in the forest canopy.

days.title: Day 9 – Full-Day 4x4 Jeep Safari Across Bardia
days.desc: Cover larger distances by open 4x4 safari jeep exploring the western grasslands and northern riverbanks of Bardia. Great opportunities for tigers, rhinos, and wild Asian elephants.

days.title: Day 10 – Final Day in Bardia & Babai River Sector
days.desc: Final intensive tracking day in Bardia exploring remote hides and river watchtowers. Evening Tharu cultural celebration and dinner.

days.title: Day 11 – Drive to Suklaphanta National Park (3 Hours)
days.desc: Drive west to Nepal's Far West frontier: Suklaphanta National Park, home to the world's largest herd of swamp deer (Barasingha) and a thriving tiger population. Settle into our local safari camp.

days.title: Day 12 – Full-Day Jeep Safari in Suklaphanta
days.desc: Explore the vast savannah grasslands of Suklaphanta by open jeep. Spot hundreds of swamp deer, wild boars, jackals, and track Bengal tigers across open vistas.

days.title: Day 13 – Second Day of Safari & Birding in Suklaphanta
days.desc: Intensive morning and afternoon safaris exploring Rani Tal lake, elephant trails, and grassland swamps. Exceptional birdlife and predator sightings.

days.title: Day 14 – Flight Back to Kathmandu
days.desc: Transfer to Dhangadhi Airport for your domestic flight to Kathmandu. Settle into your hotel, shopping in Thamel, and celebratory farewell dinner.

days.title: Day 15 – International Departure
days.desc: Private transfer to Tribhuvan International Airport for your flight back home.

title: Wild Nepal – From Dense Jungle to Sacred Annapurna Peaks – 15 Days
overview: A breathtaking contrast between the steaming subtropical jungles of the Terai and the snowcapped summits of the Himalayas. Track rhinos and tigers on foot in Bardia before ascending into the tranquil mountain villages and pine forests of the Annapurnas.
highlights: Complete ecological gradient from 150m jungle plains to 3,200m Himalayan panoramas
Walking safaris in Bardia National Park with senior native trackers
Scenic trekking in the Annapurna foothills with sunrise over Machapuchare
Serene stays in boutique eco-lodges and authentic mountain village homestays

days.title: Day 1 – Arrival in Kathmandu & Transfer to Bardia
days.desc: Arrival at Tribhuvan International Airport in Kathmandu, connect with domestic flight to Nepalgunj, and private transfer to Bardia National Park. Settle into the lodge and relax.

days.title: Day 2 – Bardia: Kingdom of Tigers & Elephants
days.desc: Full-day walking safari in Bardia National Park. Step into the domain of the Royal Bengal Tiger alongside native Tharu trackers. Watch wildlife from elevated hides and riverbanks.

days.title: Day 3 – 4x4 Jeep Safari & Canoe Drift
days.desc: Explore deeper sectors of the park by open 4x4 jeep in the morning, followed by a serene afternoon wooden canoe trip down the Geruwa River to spot mugger crocodiles and gharials.

days.title: Day 4 – Tharu Cultural Immersion
days.desc: Cycle through indigenous Tharu villages, learn about their sustainable earthen architecture, join an authentic local cooking experience, and enjoy an evening traditional dance.

days.title: Day 5 – Final Bardia Exploration & Wildlife Tracking
days.desc: Morning safari on foot to track lingering big cat traces and enjoy birdwatching. Afternoon relaxation by the river.

days.title: Day 6 – Sacred Pause in Lumbini
days.desc: Drive east to Lumbini, the birthplace of Buddha. Visit the sacred garden, Mayadevi temple, and peaceful international monasteries.

days.title: Day 7 – Heading into the Himalayas
days.desc: Scenic drive winding up from the Terai plains into the lush hills of the Annapurna region. Check into a traditional hillside village homestay with mountain views.

days.title: Day 8 – Village Walk & Mountain Panorama
days.desc: Hike through terraced rice fields and oak forests. Enjoy panoramic vistas of Annapurna South, Hiunchuli, and the sacred Fishtail peak (Machapuchare).

days.title: Day 9 – Waterfalls & Vulture Restaurant Conservation
days.desc: Hike to secluded mountain waterfalls and visit a community vulture conservation restaurant, observing endangered Himalayan griffons and white-rumped vultures.

days.title: Day 10 – Rest & Local Life in the Foothills
days.desc: A leisurely day in the village. Participate in daily agricultural activities, drink local Himalayan tea, and soak in mountain tranquility.

days.title: Day 11 – Drive to Medieval Bandipur
days.desc: Drive to the charming ridge-top town of Bandipur, celebrated for its preserved 18th-century Newari architecture, slate-paved streets, and sweeping Himalayan panoramas.

days.title: Day 12 – The Royal City of Bhaktapur
days.desc: Drive toward Kathmandu Valley and check into Bhaktapur, the medieval City of Devotees. Wander through Durbar Square, pottery squares, and ancient brick alleyways.

days.title: Day 13 – Cultural Wonders of Kathmandu
days.desc: Explore Kathmandu's most sacred monuments: the great stupa of Boudhanath and the cremation ghats of Pashupatinath on the Bagmati River.

days.title: Day 14 – Scenic Ridge of Nagarkot
days.desc: Short drive to Nagarkot for a panoramic Himalayan sunset and sunrise view stretching from the Annapurnas to Mount Everest. Farewell dinner.

days.title: Day 15 – Transfer to International Airport
days.desc: Private transfer to Tribhuvan International Airport for your flight home.

title: Chitwan + Bardia – The Complete Nepal Jungle Safari – 11 Days
overview: Why choose between Nepal's two greatest national parks? This ultimate wildlife safari takes you from the lush riverine grasslands of Chitwan (rhino paradise) to the deep, untamed sal forests of Bardia (tiger kingdom).
highlights: Direct immersion in Nepal's two crown-jewel national parks
Greater One-Horned Rhinoceros tracking in Chitwan & Bengal Tiger tracking in Bardia
Multiple safari modes: open 4x4 jeep, traditional dugout canoes, and walking safaris
Comfortable boutique lodges and personalized wildlife mentoring

days.title: Day 1 – Arrival in Kathmandu
days.desc: Welcome at Tribhuvan International Airport by our team. Private transfer to your hotel. Rest, leisure time in Thamel, and evening expedition briefing with your guide.

days.title: Day 2 – Kathmandu Valley Cultural Heritage
days.desc: Full-day exploration of UNESCO World Heritage gems: the ancient stupa of Swayambhunath (Monkey Temple) and the sacred temple complex of Pashupatinath. Evening preparations for the jungle.

days.title: Day 3 – Drive to Chitwan National Park
days.desc: Picturesque drive descending from the Kathmandu Valley into the subtropical lowlands of the Terai. Arrival in Chitwan, check-in at the eco-lodge, and sunset walk along the Rapti River.

days.title: Day 4 – Chitwan Jungle Safari & Tharu Culture
days.desc: Morning river canoe drift to observe sunbathing crocodiles and aquatic birds. Afternoon 4x4 jeep safari tracking rhinos and sloth bears. Evening Tharu cultural dance performance.

days.title: Day 5 – Drive to Lumbini & Sacred Gardens
days.desc: Drive west to Lumbini, the sacred birthplace of Siddhartha Gautama (the Buddha). Explore the Maya Devi Temple, the sacred pond, and international monastic peace zones.

days.title: Day 6 – Journey to Untamed Bardia
days.desc: Travel further west into raw Nepal, reaching Bardia National Park. Settle into our intimate eco-lodge on the edge of the wilderness. Evening briefing on tiger tracking.

days.title: Day 7 – First Safari in Bardia National Park
days.desc: Full-day safari combining 4x4 jeep and guided walking in core tiger territories. Station at strategic river crossings and waterholes where wild tigers come to quench their thirst.

days.title: Day 8 – Into the Wild: Babai River Valley Expedition
days.desc: Venture into the pristine Babai Valley, an isolated sector restricted to deep conservation. River walks and silent tracking along sandy banks for fresh predator pugmarks.

days.title: Day 9 – Wild Forest Treks & Raft Drift
days.desc: Full day dedicated to walking tracking with our native master trackers. Peaceful river descent on a raft, observing wild elephants and riverine fauna from the water.

days.title: Day 10 – Final Safari & Village Visit
days.desc: Final morning safari to catch lingering wildlife sightings. Afternoon bicycle tour of peaceful local Tharu villages. Farewell dinner with our tracking crew.

days.title: Day 11 – Domestic Flight to Kathmandu & Departure
days.desc: Transfer to Nepalgunj Airport and domestic flight to Kathmandu. Connect with your international flight home.

title: Bardia Explorer – 5 Days in the Wild Jungle
overview: This 5-day adventure is designed for wildlife lovers seeking the raw, untamed beauty of Bardia National Park. Track wild Bengal tigers, Asian one-horned rhinos, and wild elephants on foot alongside our expert local Tharu master trackers.
highlights: Full-day walking safari tracking Bengal tigers with senior trackers
4x4 open jeep safari deep into remote core zones of Bardia
Traditional river canoe safari on the Karnali & Geruwa rivers
Authentic Tharu cultural village immersion and organic local cuisine
Charming riverside ecolodge accommodation at the edge of the park

days.title: Day 1 – Arrival in Nepalgunj & Half-Day Safari
days.desc: Flight from Kathmandu to Nepalgunj, greeted by our local team, followed by a 2-hour private transfer to Bardia. Check-in at our riverside ecolodge. In the afternoon, set out for a first gentle walking safari around the park boundaries to observe birdlife and spotted deer. Evening briefing on tracking techniques. Dinner at the lodge.

days.title: Day 2 – Full-Day 4x4 Jeep Safari
days.desc: Depart at dawn in an open 4x4 safari jeep with our senior tracker and park ranger. Cross riverbeds, dense sal tree forests, and wide elephant-grass savannahs. Strategic stops at natural watering holes and machans (elevated watchtowers) for prime tiger spotting. Picnic lunch inside the park. Return at sunset for dinner.

days.title: Day 3 – Rafting Safari – Wildlife Viewing from the River
days.desc: Board a quiet inflatable raft for an exceptional drift down the Geruwa and Karnali rivers. Gliding silently on the water offers unmatched opportunities to observe wild Asian elephants drinking at the shore, marsh mugger crocodiles, and rare Gangetic freshwater dolphins. Picnic lunch on a secluded sandbank.

days.title: Day 4 – Walking Jungle Safari & Tharu Cultural Immersion
days.desc: A full day on foot in the jungle with two certified local master trackers. Experience the sensory thrill of tracking animals by their paw prints and alarm calls. In the late afternoon, visit an authentic Tharu indigenous village and attend a traditional evening cultural dance.

days.title: Day 5 – Return to Nepalgunj & Flight to Kathmandu
days.desc: Enjoy a final peaceful breakfast listening to hornbills and birdsong. Private transfer to Nepalgunj Airport for your domestic flight to Kathmandu.

Charming riverside ecolodge accommodation at the edge of the park

title: Chitwan – Wildlife Safari & Indigenous Culture – 4 Days
overview: A rich, immersive short stay combining the thrill of wildlife safaris with the warmth of local indigenous culture. Chitwan is Asia's prime sanctuary for observing the Greater One-Horned Rhinoceros, vibrant birdlife, and the traditional way of life of the Tharu people.
highlights: Thrilling 4x4 open jeep safari in Chitwan National Park
Peaceful dugout canoe drift on the Rapti river observing gharials and rhinos
Traditional Tharu cultural dance performance and village exploration
Comfortable stay in an authentic riverside eco-resort

days.title: Day 1 – Transfer to Chitwan & Sunset on the Rapti
days.desc: Scenic private transfer or flight from Kathmandu to Chitwan (Sauraha). Settle into your charming riverside eco-lodge. In the late afternoon, enjoy a peaceful sunset walk along the Rapti River, frequently visited by rhinos coming down to bathe. Traditional dinner at the lodge.

days.title: Day 2 – Jungle Safari Adventure & River Canoe
days.desc: Glide down the calm Rapti River in a traditional wooden dugout canoe, viewing endangered fish-eating gharials, mugger crocodiles, and kingfishers. Continue on a guided nature walk into the buffer zone, followed by an afternoon open 4x4 jeep safari deep inside Chitwan National Park tracking rhinos, sloth bears, and leopards.

days.title: Day 3 – Tharu Village Immersion & Birdwatching
days.desc: Early morning birdwatching tour with a specialist guide (Chitwan hosts over 500 avian species). After breakfast, explore traditional Tharu villages by foot or ox-cart. In the evening, attend an authentic Tharu stick dance performance celebrating local history and animist traditions.

days.title: Day 4 – Return to Kathmandu or Pokhara
days.desc: Enjoy a relaxed breakfast overlooking the river. Private transfer back to Kathmandu or onward to the tranquil lakes of Pokhara.

title: Wild Rivers & Hidden Heritage – Rafting & Safari Expedition – 18 Days
overview: Embark on an extraordinary journey through Nepal blending ancient cultural heritage, untouched nature, and adrenaline-pumping wild river rafting. From Kathmandu's royal palaces to the roaring gorges of the Bheri and pristine safaris in Bardia.
highlights: Multi-day self-sufficient wild river rafting with sandbank riverside bivouacs
Walking and jeep safaris in the remote heart of Bardia National Park
Exploration of UNESCO World Heritage medieval cities in Kathmandu Valley
Total immersion in Nepal's untamed western wilderness and Magar villages

days.title: Day 1 – Arrival in Kathmandu
days.desc: Welcome at Tribhuvan International Airport by our team. Private transfer to your hotel. Rest, leisure time in Thamel, and evening expedition briefing.

days.title: Day 2 – Exploration of Kathmandu Valley
days.desc: Discover the rich cultural heritage of Kathmandu: Swayambhunath stupa, Pashupatinath, and historic Newar streets.

days.title: Day 3 – Drive to Pokhara
days.desc: Scenic road journey along the Trishuli and Marsyangdi rivers to the peaceful lakeside city of Pokhara beneath the Annapurnas.

days.title: Day 4 – Exploration of Pokhara
days.desc: Sunrise view from Sarangkot over the Annapurna range, boat ride on Phewa Lake, and visit to Devi's Falls and Tibetan settlements.

days.title: Day 5 – Drive to Dhorpatan Hunting Reserve
days.desc: Off-road 4x4 expedition into Dhorpatan Hunting Reserve, Nepal's only hunting reserve, famous for blue sheep (bharal) and alpine meadows.

days.title: Day 6 – Exploration of Dhorpatan Wilderness
days.desc: Hike across high-altitude plateaus and pine forests observing wildlife and traditional pastoral communities.

days.title: Day 7 – Journey to Taksera (Magar Heritage Village)
days.desc: Drive through dramatic mountain terrain to Taksera, an ancient Magar village with distinct stone architecture and shamanic traditions.

days.title: Day 8 – Drive to Maikot (Hidden Mountain Gem)
days.desc: Cross rugged valleys to Maikot, a remote hamlet untouched by modern tourism, surrounded by steep pine-covered peaks.

days.title: Day 9 – Drive to Rukumkot & Lotus Lake
days.desc: Journey to picturesque Rukumkot, known as the place of 52 lakes and 53 hills, visiting Kamal Pokhari (Lotus Lake).

days.title: Day 10 – Drive to Surkhet Valley
days.desc: Descend from the mountains into the broad subtropical valley of Surkhet, gateway to the Karnali and Bheri rivers.

days.title: Day 11 – Launch of the Bheri River Rafting Expedition
days.desc: Meet our expert river guides, complete safety training, and launch rafts onto the crystal-clear waters of the Bheri River. Camp on a pristine white sandbank.

days.title: Day 12 – Thrilling River Rapids & Wilderness Camping
days.desc: Full day of exhilarating Class III-IV white-water rafting through secluded canyons inaccessible by road. Second night in riverside bush camp under the stars.

days.title: Day 13 – Final River Rapids & Transfer to Bardia
days.desc: Complete the river descent to the confluence with the Karnali River. Pack up rafts and private transfer to our jungle eco-lodge in Bardia.

days.title: Day 14 – Full-Day 4x4 Jeep Safari in Bardia
days.desc: Enter Bardia National Park for a full day of open-top jeep tracking targeting Royal Bengal tigers, Asian rhinos, and wild elephant herds.

days.title: Day 15 – Second Safari & Walking Track in Bardia
days.desc: Intensive tracking on foot with our native Tharu master trackers along prime tiger corridors and river crossing points.

days.title: Day 16 – Final Safari & Tharu Cultural Performance
days.desc: Morning safari followed by an evening celebration with local Tharu dances and traditional festive meal.

days.title: Day 17 – Domestic Flight to Kathmandu
days.desc: Private transfer to Nepalgunj Airport and flight back to Kathmandu. Free evening in Thamel for shopping and farewell dinner.

days.title: Day 18 – International Departure
days.desc: Private airport transfer for your departure flight with unforgettable Himalayan memories.

title: Bardia Wild Night – Jungle Immersion & Bush Camping – 3 Days
overview: An intense, authentic micro-adventure in the deep forest of Bardia. Spend a magical night under the stars listening to the nocturnal calls of the jungle, preceded and followed by intensive tracking on foot with our veteran wildlife rangers.
highlights: Exclusive wilderness bush camp inside a safe forest clearing
Sunset and sunrise tiger and elephant tracking on foot
Campfire dinner under the Himalayan starry canopy
High-adrenaline sensory encounter with raw nature

days.title: Day 1 – Pickup in Nepalgunj & Forest Immersion
days.desc: Greeting at Nepalgunj Airport and scenic drive to Bardia. After lunch and gear preparation at the lodge, set out on foot with your master trackers into the park. Observe wildlife settling down for the night. Return to the lodge for dinner and safety briefing for tomorrow's bush camp.

days.title: Day 2 – Full-Day Safari & Wild Camp in the Jungle
days.desc: Depart early by open 4x4 jeep and on foot into core wildlife territory. Track tiger pugmarks, observe rhinos at watering holes, and hike to our designated wilderness campsite. Set up camp, share a campfire dinner prepared by our camp chef, and spend an unforgettable night listening to the nocturnal jungle symphony.

days.title: Day 3 – Sunrise Tracking & Return to Village
days.desc: Early morning tracking on foot at first light when predators are most active. Return to camp for a warm breakfast, pack up, and track back through the forest to the lodge. Freshen up before private transfer to Nepalgunj Airport.

title_en: Bardia Wild Night – Jungle Immersion & Bush Camping – 3 Days

highlights_en: Exclusive wilderness bush camp inside a safe forest clearing
Sunset and sunrise tiger and elephant tracking on foot
Campfire dinner under the Himalayan starry canopy
High-adrenaline sensory encounter with raw nature

title: Rara Lake & Bardia Expedition – The Ultimate Off-the-Beaten-Path Adventure – 17 Days
overview: An epic overland crossing uniting the sapphire alpine waters of Rara Lake at 3,000 meters with the dense subtropical tiger jungles of Bardia. Experience remote Himalayan villages, alpine forests, and wild river valleys untouched by modern tourism.
highlights: Trekking around the crystal-clear sapphire waters of Lake Rara (3,000m)
Deep wildlife tracking in Bardia National Park's pristine tiger corridors
Pristine off-grid Himalayan mountain villages and sacred temples
Private 4x4 overland expedition through Western Nepal's hidden gems

days.title: Day 1 – Arrival in Kathmandu
days.desc: Arrival at Tribhuvan International Airport, meet our expedition team, private transfer to hotel, and leisure time in Thamel.

days.title: Day 2 – Cultural Exploration of Kathmandu
days.desc: Explore the historic temples of Kathmandu Valley: Pashupatinath, Boudhanath, and Kathmandu Durbar Square.

days.title: Day 3 – Drive to Pokhara
days.desc: Scenic road trip to Pokhara, nestled beside Phewa Lake with views of the Annapurna mountain range.

days.title: Day 4 – Exploration of Pokhara Valley
days.desc: Boating on Phewa Lake, visiting World Peace Pagoda, and exploring local mountain viewpoints.

days.title: Day 5 – Drive to Lumbini (Birthplace of Buddha)
days.desc: Drive southwest to Lumbini and tour the sacred Mayadevi Temple and monastic garden complexes.

days.title: Day 6 – Drive to Surkhet
days.desc: Journey northwest through rural hill roads into the historic valley of Surkhet in Western Nepal.

days.title: Day 7 – Scenic Road to Kalikot
days.desc: Ascend dramatic gorges along the Karnali Highway to Kalikot, enjoying rugged mountain panoramas.

days.title: Day 8 – Arrival at Sapphire Lake Rara
days.desc: Drive and hike through rhododendron and pine forests to reach Lake Rara (3,000m), Nepal's largest and most pristine alpine lake.

days.title: Day 9 – Exploration of Lake Rara & Murma Top
days.desc: Trek around the sapphire lakeshore and hike up to Murma Top (3,700m) for a 360° panoramic view of the lake and snowy peaks.

days.title: Day 10 – Return Drive to Kalikot
days.desc: Bid farewell to Lake Rara and retrace the mountain track back down to Kalikot for an overnight stop.

days.title: Day 11 – Drive South to Bardia National Park
days.desc: Descend from the mountains into the warm Terai lowlands, arriving at our tranquil jungle lodge at Bardia.

days.title: Day 12 – Full-Day 4x4 Safari in Bardia
days.desc: Dawn-to-dusk jeep safari exploring prime tiger and rhino habitats across Bardia with expert trackers.

days.title: Day 13 – Second Day of Intensive Safari
days.desc: Explore riverine forests, watchtowers, and natural watering holes for big cats and Asian elephants.

days.title: Day 14 – Walking Safari & Deep Jungle Immersion
days.desc: Experience the pulse of the jungle on foot with our native Tharu trackers. Safe, quiet, and thrilling close-up nature tracking.

days.title: Day 15 – Leisure Day & Tharu Village Walk
days.desc: Relax at the lodge, visit local village artisans, and enjoy an evening traditional Tharu cultural celebration.

days.title: Day 16 – Flight to Kathmandu
days.desc: Short drive to Nepalgunj Airport for domestic flight back to Kathmandu. Free afternoon for shopping.

days.title: Day 17 – International Departure
days.desc: Private transfer to airport for your return flight home.

title: Bardia Babai Valley – Wild Camping in Untamed Nature – 8 Days
overview: The Babai Valley is Bardia's most secret, untouched sanctuary. Reserved for true adventurers, this multi-day wild camping expedition takes you deep into isolated gorges where wild herds of elephants, Bengal tigers, and elusive leopards roam freely without any tourist crowds.
highlights: Several consecutive nights of mobile wild camping along the Babai River
Strictly restricted conservation territory with virtually zero tourist presence
Unrivaled wildlife observation: wild tigers, rhinos, sloth bears, and Asian elephants
Accompanied by senior government rangers and native Tharu master trackers

days.title: Day 1 – Arrival & First Steps into the Wild
days.desc: Arrival at Nepalgunj Airport and private scenic transfer to Bardia. Settle into the lodge, meet your naturalist guides, and receive a complete safety and expedition briefing. Take an evening walk around the lodge to spot golden jackals and birdlife. Dinner and overnight at the lodge.

days.title: Day 2 – Tracking Tigers & Ascending the River
days.desc: Early departure to the entrance of the Babai Valley. Begin walking tracking along the riverbeds where predator tracks are fresh in the morning sand. Establish the first wild camp on a secure sandbank. Campfire dinner and night in tents listening to nocturnal jungle calls.

days.title: Day 3 – Into the Heart of Babai
days.desc: A full day dedicated to tracking big cats and herds of wild elephants. Hike through dense sal forests, tall elephant grass, and rocky gorges. Strategic waiting posts at natural water points. Second night of wild camping under the pristine Himalayan night sky.

days.title: Day 4 – From River to Forest Canopies
days.desc: Continue exploring the remote valley corridors. Observe marsh deer (Barasingha), nilgai antelopes, and endangered gharials basking in the sun. Third night in wilderness bivouac with our field camp crew.

days.title: Day 5 – Full-Day 4x4 Jeep Safari
days.desc: Exit the deep valley and transition to an open 4x4 safari jeep to cover greater distances across the western grasslands and riverbanks of Bardia. Return to the comfort of the eco-lodge for a hot shower and hearty local dinner.

days.title: Day 6 – Rest & Life on the Riverbanks
days.desc: A slower-paced day dedicated to river observation. Traditional wooden dugout canoe drift on the Geruwa River, peaceful photography pauses, and birdwatching. Overnight at the eco-lodge.

days.title: Day 7 – Tharu Cultural Immersion Day
days.desc: Visit traditional Tharu villages on foot or by bicycle. Discover their mud-and-thatch architecture, organic agriculture, and animist traditions. Evening cultural performance and traditional feast.

days.title: Day 8 – Return to Kathmandu
days.desc: Final breakfast in the peaceful jungle morning. Private transfer to Nepalgunj Airport and flight back to Kathmandu.

title_en: Bardia Babai Valley – Wild Camping in Untamed Nature – 8 Days
overview_en: The Babai Valley is Bardia's most secret, untouched sanctuary. Reserved for true adventurers, this multi-day wild camping expedition takes you deep into isolated gorges where wild herds of elephants, Bengal tigers, and elusive leopards roam freely without any tourist crowds.
highlights_en: Several consecutive nights of mobile wild camping along the Babai River
Strictly restricted conservation territory with virtually zero tourist presence
Unrivaled wildlife observation: wild tigers, rhinos, sloth bears, and Asian elephants
Accompanied by senior government rangers and native Tharu master trackers

title: Nepal Total Immersion – Culture, Wildlife & Adventure – 14 Days
overview: The complete 360° quintessential Nepal journey. Experience the spiritual majesty of Kathmandu Valley, the tranquility of Pokhara beneath the Annapurnas, thrilling river rafting, and intense wildlife safaris in both Chitwan and Bardia.
highlights: Comprehensive grand loop: Kathmandu, Pokhara, Trishuli river, Chitwan & Bardia
River rafting adventure with scenic riverside lunch
Walking and jeep safaris with maximum tiger and rhino encounter odds
Cultural encounters with Newar, Gurung, and Tharu communities

days.title: Day 1 – Arrival in Kathmandu
days.desc: Welcome at the airport, private transfer to your hotel, trip briefing, and evening welcome dinner in Thamel.

days.title: Day 2 – Kathmandu Heritage Tour
days.desc: Visit UNESCO World Heritage sites: Swayambhunath (Monkey Temple), Patan Durbar Square, and Pashupatinath.

days.title: Day 3 – Ancient Bhaktapur & Sunset at Nagarkot
days.desc: Explore the medieval brick architecture of Bhaktapur, followed by a scenic drive to Nagarkot for panoramic Himalayan views.

days.title: Day 4 – Trishuli River Rafting & Drive to Chitwan
days.desc: Exciting 3-hour river rafting descent on the Trishuli River. Riverside lunch and drive to Chitwan National Park.

days.title: Day 5 – Full-Day Safari in Chitwan
days.desc: 4x4 jeep safari tracking one-horned rhinos, sloth bears, and deer. Afternoon canoe drift on the Rapti River.

days.title: Day 6 – Nature Walk & Drive to Pokhara
days.desc: Early morning birdwatching walk, followed by a scenic 5-hour drive to picturesque Pokhara.

days.title: Day 7 – Annapurna Sunrise & Pokhara Lakes
days.desc: Sunrise over the Annapurnas from Sarangkot, boat ride across Lake Phewa, and visit to World Peace Pagoda.

days.title: Day 8 – Drive to Lumbini (Birthplace of Buddha)
days.desc: Drive to Lumbini and spend the afternoon exploring the sacred Mayadevi gardens and monastic zone.

days.title: Day 9 – Journey West to Bardia National Park
days.desc: Scenic road trip through the Terai to Bardia National Park. Settle into our authentic jungle lodge and meet tracker Pawan.

days.title: Day 10 – Full-Day 4x4 Jeep Safari in Bardia
days.desc: Full-day exploration of core tiger territories in Bardia. Strategic waits at riverbanks and watering holes.

days.title: Day 11 – Full-Day Walking Safari on Foot
days.desc: Step quietly into the jungle with two master trackers. Track tiger prints, alarm calls, and observe wildlife up close.

days.title: Day 12 – Final Safari & Tharu Cultural Evening
days.desc: Morning safari followed by an afternoon visit to traditional Tharu villages and an evening cultural dance.

days.title: Day 13 – Flight Back to Kathmandu
days.desc: Transfer to Nepalgunj Airport and domestic flight to Kathmandu. Rest, shopping, and celebratory farewell dinner.

days.title: Day 14 – International Departure
days.desc: Private transfer to Tribhuvan International Airport for your return flight.

title: Deep Into the Wild: Babai Special Experience – 5 Days
overview: This is not a simple jungle walk. It is an exclusive expedition into one of Nepal's most secluded, pristine wilderness areas. The Babai Valley lies deep within Bardia National Park, far beyond standard safari routes. Very few travelers ever set foot here, and fewer still spend the night on the wild shores of its river in the heart of royal tiger territory.
highlights: Scenic river boat safaris and deep walking tracking in core tiger zones
Full-day open 4x4 jeep safari and wilderness tracking on foot
Traditional cultural evening and dinner with the local Tharu community
Exclusive riverside bush camps surrounded by the raw sounds of the jungle

days.title: Day 1 – Welcome to the Untamed Wilderness
days.desc: Pickup at Nepalgunj Airport or Kohalpur and private scenic transfer to the banks of the Babai River at Chepang. After lunch, enjoy a peaceful boat safari deep inside the national park, ideal for spotting riverine wildlife, mugger crocodiles, and water birds. Upon arrival at Rhino Camp along the riverbank, check in to your tented camp. Later, take a gentle late-afternoon walk around the campsite before a hot dinner and an immersive first night under the stars.

days.title: Day 2 – On the Trail of the Bengal Tiger
days.desc: Wake up to morning tea at dawn, followed by a gentle tracking walk along the riverbanks and forest clearings. After breakfast, head out with your master tracker for an intensive tiger-tracking expedition on foot. Enjoy a riverside picnic lunch surrounded by wild nature. In the afternoon, continue hiking through deep sal forests to Nilgai Camp, your second bush campsite. Enjoy campfire dinner and a night enveloped in pure jungle sounds.

days.title: Day 3 – River Drift & Return to Lodge
days.desc: Start with early morning tea and a nature walk around the campsite. After breakfast, embark on a final guided jungle trek until lunchtime. In the afternoon, drift down the peaceful Babai River by raft or boat to the main road, where private transport awaits to take you back to our comfortable eco-lodge. Dinner and overnight stay at the lodge.

days.title: Day 4 – Western Sector Jeep Safari & Cultural Immersion
days.desc: After a relaxed breakfast, depart for a full-day open 4x4 jeep safari exploring the remote western sector of Bardia National Park. Track one-horned rhinos, wild elephants, and spotted deer. Return in the evening for dinner followed by an authentic traditional Tharu cultural dance performance, offering deep insight into the indigenous heritage of Bardia.

days.title: Day 5 – Farewell & Departure
days.desc: After breakfast, bid farewell to our local team and enjoy a private transfer to Nepalgunj Airport for your flight back to Kathmandu or on to your next adventure.

title: Tiji Festival in Upper Mustang – Forbidden Kingdom – 13 Days
overview: Journey behind the great Himalayan barrier into the ancient Kingdom of Lo (Upper Mustang). Witness the mesmerizing, sacred three-day Tiji Festival in Lo Manthang with masked lama dances, cliffside cave monasteries, and Tibetan Buddhist rituals.
highlights: Exclusive attendance at the vibrant three-day Tiji Festival in Lo Manthang
Spectacular trans-Himalayan scenery: eroded ochre canyons, caves, and snow peaks
Centuries-old Tibetan Buddhist monasteries and royal palaces
Scenic overland and domestic flight journeys through Kali Gandaki gorge

days.title: Day 1 – Arrival in Kathmandu
days.desc: Welcome at airport, private transfer to hotel, expedition briefing, and special Mustang permit processing.

days.title: Day 2 – Kathmandu Valley Heritage
days.desc: Visit sacred Buddhist sites: Boudhanath Stupa and Swayambhunath, preparing for the spiritual journey ahead.

days.title: Day 3 – Drive to Pokhara
days.desc: Scenic road transfer to Pokhara along mountain rivers. Evening stroll along Lake Phewa.

days.title: Day 4 – Drive to Kalopani via Kali Gandaki Gorge
days.desc: Enter the world's deepest gorge between Annapurna and Dhaulagiri, reaching the pine forests of Kalopani.

days.title: Day 5 – Drive to Ancient Kagbeni
days.desc: Drive through Jomsom and Marpha to Kagbeni, the medieval fortified gateway to Upper Mustang.

days.title: Day 6 – Enter Upper Mustang to Ghami
days.desc: Cross high passes with views of red cliffs, ancient sky caves, and mani walls to reach the village of Ghami.

days.title: Day 7 – Drive to the Walled Capital: Lo Manthang
days.desc: Traverse stunning desert canyons to reach the historic walled city of Lo Manthang, seat of the King of Mustang.

days.title: Day 8 – Lo Manthang – Opening of the Tiji Festival
days.desc: Witness the dramatic opening day of the Tiji Festival: sounding of long horns, unrolling of the giant Thangka, and masked sacred dances.

days.title: Day 9 – Tiji Festival Celebrations & Chhoser Caves
days.desc: Attend second day dances symbolizing the victory of dharma over demons. Afternoon visit to the multi-story Sky Caves of Chhoser.

days.title: Day 10 – Drive South to Sacred Muktinath
days.desc: Journey south to holy Muktinath (3,710m), sacred pilgrimage site for both Buddhists and Hindus with eternal natural flame.

days.title: Day 11 – Descend to Tatopani Natural Hot Springs
days.desc: Scenic drive descending the gorge to Tatopani. Relax in natural thermal hot springs beside the river.

days.title: Day 12 – Drive to Pokhara & Fly to Kathmandu
days.desc: Drive to Pokhara and connect with a short scenic flight to Kathmandu. Celebration dinner.

days.title: Day 13 – Farewell & International Departure
days.desc: Private transfer to Tribhuvan International Airport for your journey home.

title: Nepal Sketching & Travel Journaling Expedition – 15 Days
overview: An artistic and sensory voyage designed for sketchers, watercolorists, photographers, and mindful travelers. Capture the colors of ancient medieval squares, golden Himalayan dawns, and untamed wildlife with guided creative workshops.
highlights: Daily creative sketching and photography pauses in extraordinary settings
Private visits to historic temples, mountain balconies, and wild jungles
Harmonious rhythm balancing cultural immersion, nature walks, and creative free time
Warm exchanges with local painters, artisans, and monks

days.title: Day 1 – Arrival in Kathmandu
days.desc: Welcome at airport, hotel transfer, distribution of expedition sketch kits, and gentle evening walk in Thamel.

days.title: Day 2 – Medieval Bhaktapur Sketching Session
days.desc: Spend the day sketching carved wooden windows, pottery squares, and pagodas in historic Bhaktapur.

days.title: Day 3 – Drive to Bandipur Hilltop Village
days.desc: Scenic journey to Bandipur. Afternoon sketching old Newar townhouses, slate streets, and valley viewpoints.

days.title: Day 4 – Bandipur to Traditional Village of Ghachok
days.desc: Travel into the Annapurna foothills to Ghachok, an authentic farming village with stunning views of Machapuchare.

days.title: Day 5 – Watercolor Workshop in Ghachok
days.desc: Paint terraced fields, buffalos, and Himalayan peaks from village balconies. Interact with welcoming village elders.

days.title: Day 6 – Nature Walks & Forest Portraits
days.desc: Gentle nature walk through bamboo groves and mountain streams. Sketching local flora and village life.

days.title: Day 7 – Ghachok to Lakeside Pokhara
days.desc: Short drive to Pokhara. Afternoon watercolor session by Lake Phewa capturing boats and reflections.

days.title: Day 8 – Pokhara to Spiritual Lumbini
days.desc: Descend to Lumbini. Evening contemplative sketching at the sacred Mayadevi pond under the bodhi tree.

days.title: Day 9 – Travel to Bardia National Park
days.desc: Drive west through the Terai plains to Bardia. Settle into our eco-lodge and prepare for wildlife art.

days.title: Day 10 – Bardia: Sketching Riverbanks & Wildlife
days.desc: Peaceful day sketching along the Geruwa River. Observe birdlife, crocodiles, and deer at water's edge.

days.title: Day 11 – Open 4x4 Jeep Safari in Bardia
days.desc: Full-day safari combining wildlife observation and photography for field sketching references.

days.title: Day 12 – Walking Safari in the Jungle
days.desc: Quiet walking tracking in core forest zones. Quick field sketching from elevated observation towers.

days.title: Day 13 – Tharu Village Portraits & Cultural Art
days.desc: Visit local Tharu homes, learn traditional mud-wall painting techniques, and sketch village daily life.

days.title: Day 14 – Flight Back to Kathmandu
days.desc: Domestic flight from Nepalgunj to Kathmandu. Collective exhibition and sharing of journals over farewell dinner.

days.title: Day 15 – International Departure
days.desc: Private airport transfer for your departure flight.

title: Spiritual Immersion in the Himalayas & Sacred Valleys – 12 Days
overview: A transformative, meditative journey connecting with the deep sacred roots of Nepal. Discover Tibetan Buddhist monasteries, sacred Hindu cremation ghats at Pashupatinath, meditation caves, and peaceful high-altitude Himalayan retreats.
highlights: Privileged meetings and teachings with Tibetan Buddhist lamas and yogis
Dawn meditation sessions facing the snowcapped peaks of the Himalayas
Pilgrimages to sacred sites: Boudhanath, Swayambhunath, Namo Buddha, and Pokhara
Peaceful, serene rhythm fostering self-reflection and authentic connections

days.title: Day 1 – Arrival in Kathmandu
days.desc: Welcome at airport, transfer to a peaceful hotel, and introduction to the spiritual pilgrimage.

days.title: Day 2 – Kathmandu Sacred Sites & Ashram Stay
days.desc: Visit the sacred river ghats of Pashupatinath and Boudhanath Stupa before settling into a traditional ashram.

days.title: Day 3 – Ashram Life: Yoga & Meditation
days.desc: Full day of ashram routine: sunrise pranayama, guided meditation, silent reflection, and spiritual philosophy.

days.title: Day 4 – Sacred Hilltop of Namo Buddha
days.desc: Drive to the sacred pilgrimage site of Namo Buddha, where Buddha offered his body to a starving tigress.

days.title: Day 5 – Day of Noble Silence (Mouna)
days.desc: Experience a day of mindful silence, walking meditation through pine forests, and inward contemplation.

days.title: Day 6 – Journey to Pokhara Beneath the Annapurnas
days.desc: Drive to Pokhara. Settle into a tranquil hillside retreat overlooking Lake Phewa and the Himalayas.

days.title: Day 7 – Reconnecting with Nature & Lake Meditation
days.desc: Dawn meditation overlooking the Annapurna range. Quiet boat crossing of Phewa Lake and forest mindfulness walk.

days.title: Day 8 – Tibetan Monastery Teachings & Sound Healing
days.desc: Visit a Tibetan Buddhist monastery in Pokhara, participate in butter lamp offerings, and experience traditional Tibetan singing bowl sound healing.

days.title: Day 9 – Sacred Caves & Mountain Sanctuaries
days.desc: Explore ancient meditation caves, mountain viewpoints, and peaceful riverside ashrams.

days.title: Day 10 – Himalayan Foothills Pilgrimage Hike
days.desc: Gentle day hike through sacred oak forests and rhododendron trails with sweeping vistas of Fishtail Mountain.

days.title: Day 11 – Scenic Flight Back to Kathmandu
days.desc: Panoramic flight back to Kathmandu. Free afternoon for quiet reflection and farewell blessing ceremony.

days.title: Day 12 – Farewell & International Departure
days.desc: Private transfer to Tribhuvan International Airport for your journey home.

title: Exclusive Snow Leopard Expedition (17 Days)
overview: Embark on an extraordinary 17-day expedition tracking the most elusive and legendary big cat on Earth: the Snow Leopard ('Ghost of the Mountains'). High in the remote wilderness of Manang (3,600m – 4,500m) and the Annapurnas, experience 9 full field days of intensive tracking alongside expert Himalayan trackers, progressive altitude acclimatization, and ancient Buddhist heritage at the 600-year-old Braka Gompa monastery.
overview_en: Embark on an extraordinary 17-day expedition tracking the most elusive and legendary big cat on Earth: the Snow Leopard ('Ghost of the Mountains'). High in the remote wilderness of Manang (3,600m – 4,500m) and the Annapurnas, experience 9 full field days of intensive tracking alongside expert Himalayan trackers, progressive altitude acclimatization, and ancient Buddhist heritage at the 600-year-old Braka Gompa monastery.
highlights: 9 full days in the field dedicated to tracking and observing the Snow Leopard
Elite tracking with native Himalayan trackers and professional spotting scopes
Safe stepwise altitude acclimatization (Chame 2,700m, Manang 3,600m, Gangapurna lake)
Rich cultural discovery in Bhaktapur, Bandipur and the 600-year-old Braka Gompa monastery
Panoramic flight over the Annapurna range and relaxing natural hot springs

program.title: Arrivée à Katmandou – Transfert direct à la cité royale de Bhaktapur
program.title_en: Arrival in Kathmandu – Direct Transfer to Royal Bhaktapur
program.desc: Accueil à l'aéroport international et transfert direct vers la cité historique de Bhaktapur. Installation à l'hôtel et présentation de l'expédition. Ce choix permet une première immersion culturelle immédiate, à l'écart de l'agitation du centre de la capitale.
program.desc_en: Welcome at Kathmandu International Airport and direct transfer to the historic city of Bhaktapur. Check-in and expedition briefing. This allows immediate cultural immersion away from the bustling city center.

program.title: Vol panoramique Katmandou – Pokhara & Préparatifs face aux Annapurnas
program.title_en: Scenic Flight Kathmandu – Pokhara & Expedition Briefing
program.desc: Vol domestique de 30 minutes vers Pokhara offrant un panorama unique sur la chaîne des Annapurnas. Temps libre l’après-midi pour explorer les abords du lac Phewa, visiter les temples, organiser les derniers préparatifs et profiter de la vue sur les montagnes. Nuit à l'hôtel.
program.desc_en: 30-minute domestic flight to Pokhara with breathtaking views of the Annapurnas. Afternoon free time to stroll around Phewa Lake, visit temples, finalize gear, and enjoy mountain vistas. Overnight at hotel.

program.title: Pokhara – Chame (2 700 m) : Remontée de la vallée et sources chaudes
program.title_en: Pokhara – Chame (2,700 m): Ascending the Valley & Hot Springs
program.desc: Départ en véhicule privatif 4x4 pour Chame (environ 6h de piste). Ce trajet spectaculaire marque le début de la remontée de la vallée et constitue le premier palier d'acclimatation à l'altitude. En fin de journée, accès aux sources d'eau chaude naturelles en bord de rivière. Nuit en lodge/hôtel.
program.desc_en: Private 4x4 departure for Chame (approx. 6h drive). This scenic route marks the start of the valley ascent and serves as the first altitude acclimatization stage. In the evening, relax in natural riverside hot springs. Overnight in lodge.

program.title: Chame – Manang (3 600 m) & Randonnée d'acclimatation au Lac Gangapurna
program.title_en: Chame – Manang (3,600 m) & Acclimatization Hike to Gangapurna Lake
program.desc: Trajet de 2 heures en véhicule pour rejoindre Manang (3 600 m). Pour valider ce deuxième palier de contrôle d'acclimatation, une marche est programmée l'après-midi vers le lac glaciaire turquoise de Gangapurna. Nuit à l'hôtel/lodge à Manang.
program.desc_en: 2-hour drive to reach Manang (3,600 m). To secure proper acclimatization, an afternoon hike is scheduled to the turquoise glacial Gangapurna Lake. Overnight in lodge in Manang.

program.title: Expédition Léopard des Neiges – 9 Jours de suivi et de pistage intensif
program.title_en: Snow Leopard Expedition – 9 Days of Intensive Field Tracking
program.desc: Neuf jours complets sur le terrain dédiés au suivi, à la recherche d'indices (empreintes, grattages, proies) et à l'observation du Léopard des neiges dans ses vallées refuges. Chaque jour, départ matinal avec nos pisteurs himalayens expérimentés munis de longues-vues HD. L'itinéraire intègre une flexibilité permettant d'effectuer une journée de césure et de transition culturelle au monastère de Braka Gompa, un site historique majeur vieux de 600 ans.
program.desc_en: Nine full days in the field dedicated to tracking, searching for signs (pugmarks, scrapes, kills), and observing the Snow Leopard in its high-altitude habitat. Daily early morning scouting with veteran Himalayan spotters and high-end scopes. Includes flexible schedule with a cultural transition day visiting the 600-year-old Braka Gompa monastery.

program.title: Manang – Bandipur : Descente des hautes terres vers la cité Newar
program.title_en: Manang – Bandipur: Descending to the Preserved Newar Town
program.desc: Amorce de la descente des hautes altitudes. Trajet de 6 à 7 heures de route panoramique pour rejoindre Bandipur, un village traditionnel Newar piéton reconnu pour son architecture népalaise remarquablement préservée et son panorama splendide sur les sommets. Nuit sur place.
program.desc_en: Beginning the descent from high altitudes. 6-7 hours scenic drive to Bandipur, a charming, vehicle-free Newar village celebrated for its preserved 18th-century architecture and Himalayan sunset views. Overnight in Bandipur.

program.title: Bandipur – Katmandou & Soirée libre à Thamel
program.title_en: Bandipur – Kathmandu & Free Evening in Thamel
program.desc: Route de retour vers la vallée de Katmandou (environ 4h de trajet). Installation à l'hôtel et fin de journée libre pour se reposer, flâner dans les ruelles animées du quartier de Thamel et savourer un dîner traditionnel népalais.
program.desc_en: Drive back to Kathmandu Valley (approx. 4h). Hotel check-in and free evening to relax, shop in Thamel's vibrant streets, and enjoy a celebratory farewell dinner.

program.title: Katmandou : Joyaux du patrimoine mondial UNESCO & Thamel
program.title_en: Kathmandu: UNESCO World Heritage Highlights & Cultural Tour
program.desc: Journée consacrée à la découverte approfondie des grands sites culturels et spirituels de la vallée de Katmandou (stūpa de Swayambhunath, temple sacré de Pashupatinath ou grande place royale). Derniers achats d'artisanat local à Thamel.
program.desc_en: Comprehensive guided tour of Kathmandu Valley's UNESCO World Heritage gems (Swayambhunath Monkey Temple, sacred Pashupatinath, or Durbar Square). Final souvenir shopping in Thamel.

program.title: Transfert aéroport & Vol retour
program.desc: Transfert privatif à l'aéroport international de Katmandou selon l'horaire de votre vol pour votre départ, avec des souvenirs inoubliables du Fantôme des Montagnes.
program.desc_en: Private transfer to Kathmandu International Airport according to your flight schedule, departing with unforgettable memories of the Mountain Ghost.

days.title: Day 1 – Arrival in Kathmandu – Transfer to Historic Bhaktapur
days.desc: Welcome at the international airport and private transfer directly to the historic medieval city of Bhaktapur. Check into your hotel for an expedition presentation. This choice offers immediate cultural immersion away from the bustling capital center.

days.title: Day 2 – Scenic Flight Kathmandu to Pokhara: Annapurna Panorama
days.desc: 30-minute domestic flight to Pokhara offering breathtaking vistas of the Annapurna mountain range. Afternoon at leisure around Lake Phewa to make final gear checks and enjoy the mountains.

days.title: Day 3 – Pokhara to Chame (2,700 m): 4x4 Trail & Hot Springs
days.desc: Depart by private 4x4 for Chame (approx. 6h trail). Marks the beginning of the valley ascent and the first altitude acclimatization stage. In the late afternoon, enjoy natural thermal hot springs beside the river.

days.title: Day 4 – Chame to Manang (3,600 m) & Gangapurna Lake Acclimatization Hike
days.desc: 2-hour drive to reach Manang. To safely validate this second acclimatization tier, embark on a hike toward the turquoise glacial lake of Gangapurna. Overnight in Manang.

days.title: Days 5 to 13 (9 Days) – Snow Leopard Tracking Expedition
days.desc: Nine full days in the field dedicated to tracking and observing the Snow Leopard alongside our experienced Himalayan master trackers equipped with Swarovski HD spotting scopes. Flexible pacing includes cultural transition at the 600-year-old Braka Gompa monastery.

days.title: Day 14 – Manang to Bandipur: Valley Descent & Traditional Newar Village
days.desc: Begin descending from high altitude. 6 to 7-hour road journey to Bandipur, a traditional Newar village renowned for preserved 18th-century architecture and mountain vistas.

days.title: Day 15 – Bandipur to Kathmandu & Leisure Evening in Thamel
days.desc: Return drive to Kathmandu (approx. 4 hours). Check into hotel and enjoy free time to rest and explore Thamel's vibrant artisan alleys.

days.title: Day 16 – Kathmandu Valley UNESCO Cultural Heritage
days.desc: Full day discovering the greatest cultural monuments of the Kathmandu Valley (Swayambhunath, Pashupatinath, ancient artisan streets).

days.title: Day 17 – Airport Transfer & International Departure
days.desc: Private transfer to Tribhuvan International Airport for your return flight with unforgettable memories of the Ghost of the Mountains.
